name: Forward Enterprise
description: Builds a model of a hybrid network from device and cloud state and configuration, so teams can search it, verify its behavior and test proposed changes before deployment.

description_source.quote: Forward Enterprise builds a mathematically accurate digital twin of your network, ingesting state and configuration from every router, switch, firewall, load balancer, and public cloud instance to create a single verified model of how your entire network behaves, right now, historically, and into the future.

license_source.quote: Forward is priced as a modular subscription.

claims.quote: Forward Enterprise builds a mathematically accurate digital twin of your network, ingesting state and configuration from every router, switch, firewall, load balancer, and public cloud instance to create a single verified model of how your entire network behaves, right now, historically, and into the future.
claims.reasoning: Storing and analysing the actual network state in a model, including history, is the main purpose of the product.

claims.quote: ingesting state and configuration from every router, switch, firewall, load balancer, and public cloud instance
claims.reasoning: The product reads state and configuration from network devices and cloud instances to build its model.

claims.quote: Continuously enforce business rules against the digital twin. Custom intent checks validate forwarding behavior, segmentation, and policy.
claims.reasoning: The product stores and checks operational expectations (intent checks), but it is not where the desired configuration of the network is defined.

notes: The company names itself both "Forward" and "Forward Networks" on its home page. The pricing page states licensing "per modelled device". The home page offers a free trial; no source states a free or open-source edition.
